description: This file defines functionality for adding a follower relationship between users in a social media or blogging application. It includes command validation, handling the add follower request, checking existing relationships, and returning the profile of the followed user.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains nested classes for command, validation, and handler logic for adding a follower.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to add a follower, checks for existing users, creates the follower relationship if not already present, and returns the target user's profile.
